100 km in euros

With my real usage: 13–14 kWh per 100 km in summer and 18–19 in winter. This is what a page of the guide looks like.

€3.2Home, summer · $3.5013.5 kWh × €0.23
€4.3Home, winter · $4.7018.5 kWh × €0.23
€5.4Supercharger, summer · $6.0013.5 kWh × €0.39
€7.3Supercharger, winter · $8.0018.5 kWh × €0.39
€8.8Other charger, winter · $9.7018.5 kWh × €0.48

My prices in Romania, November 2026: about €0.23 per kWh at home, €0.39 at a Supercharger and €0.48 at another fast network without a subscription. The guide shows you how to use your own prices.

Frequently asked questions

What do I get after paying?

A 37-page PDF in 10 chapters. You download it right away from your Whop account and read it on your phone, tablet or computer.

Is it useful if I haven't ordered a Tesla yet?

Yes. Chapter 1 covers what to sort out while you wait for the car (paperwork, insurance, home charging), and chapter 10 compares Model 3 with Model Y and the 2026 versions.

Is it only for Model Y?

No. I drive a Model Y Long Range, but the settings, charging, winter, maintenance and the delivery checklist apply to Model 3 too.

I don't live in Romania. Is it still for me?

Yes. My examples and prices come from Romania, my home market, but they're shown in euros and dollars and the guide tells you how to use your own prices. The car, its settings and the checks are the same everywhere.

Can I print the delivery checklist?

Yes. The checklist on page 10 is made to be printed and ticked off on delivery day, before you sign.

Is this an official Tesla guide?

No. It's my guide, from my own experience. It is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Tesla, Inc.
